definition: a person who does work without being paid; to do such work
vi: tình nguyện viên; làm tình nguyện
example: I volunteer at the community kitchen every second Saturday.

definition: a public building where people in an area meet for activities and services
example: The community centre offers free English conversation circles on Tuesday evenings.

definition: an organization that collects food and gives it to people in need
vi: ngân hàng thực phẩm (nơi phát thực phẩm miễn phí)
example: Demand at the local food bank has risen sharply as grocery prices go up.

definition: an activity you can join without booking in advance
vi: chương trình tham gia tự do (không cần đăng ký trước)
example: The library runs a drop-in program for parents and toddlers every Wednesday morning.

definition: to put your name on a list to take part in something
example: I signed up for a free tax clinic at the neighbourhood house.

definition: programs that help immigrants settle in a new country
vi: dịch vụ hỗ trợ người mới nhập cư
example: MOSAIC and other agencies offer newcomer services such as job search help and language classes.

definition: without any cost
example: The workshop is free of charge, but space is limited to twenty people.

definition: a card that lets you borrow books and use library services
example: With a library card, you can also borrow museum passes and e-books.

definition: an event organized to collect money for a cause
example: Our school's pancake breakfast fundraiser raised over $3,000 for new playground equipment.

definition: money or goods given to help a person or organization
vi: sự quyên góp, đồ/tiền quyên góp
example: The shelter accepts donations of winter coats and blankets.

definition: a group that uses its income to help people rather than make a profit
example: She works for a non-profit organization that helps refugees find housing.

definition: efforts to bring services or information to people who need them
vi: hoạt động tiếp cận cộng đồng
example: The health authority expanded its outreach to seniors who live alone.

definition: older people, usually over 65
example: The centre offers chair yoga and computer classes for seniors.

definition: a place or service that looks after young children while parents work
vi: nhà trẻ, dịch vụ giữ trẻ ban ngày
example: The waiting list for a licensed daycare in our area is over a year long.

definition: an organized activity for teenagers or young people
vi: chương trình dành cho thanh thiếu niên
example: The after-school youth program keeps teens busy with sports and homework help.

definition: a short class where people learn a practical skill together
vi: hội thảo thực hành, lớp học kỹ năng ngắn hạn
example: I attended a résumé workshop that showed me how to write for Canadian employers.

definition: lessons for learning a language
example: Permanent residents can take free English language classes through the LINC program.

definition: a group of people with a similar problem who meet to help each other
vi: nhóm hỗ trợ, nhóm tương trợ
example: After moving to Canada, my mother joined a support group for new grandparents.

definition: earning little money
example: The program offers free bus passes to low-income families.

definition: to have a good effect on a person or situation
vi: tạo ra sự khác biệt, có tác động tích cực
example: Even an hour a week of volunteering can make a difference in a child's life.
collocations: make a difference in the community

definition: to help the place and people that have helped you
vi: đóng góp lại cho cộng đồng
example: After the settlement agency helped my family, I wanted to give back to the community.
collocations: a way to give back to the community
want to give back to the community

definition: information passed from person to person by talking
example: Most new members heard about the club by word of mouth, not through ads.

definition: anyone is allowed to come
example: The town hall meeting is open to the public, and no registration is required.
collocations: free and open to the public
open to the public on weekends

definition: a list of people waiting for something that is not yet available
example: The swimming lessons are full, but I can put your name on the waiting list.

definition: a shared piece of land where local people grow plants and vegetables
example: We rent a small plot in the community garden and grow tomatoes every summer.

definition: one of several local buildings that belong to the same public library system
example: The library branch near my house is closed on Mondays.

definition: to help someone, especially by doing part of their work
example: My teenage son helps out at the community centre every Saturday morning.

definition: an organization that collects money or goods to help people in need
example: We donate our old clothes to a local charity every spring.

definition: an activity organized for the people who live in a local area
example: The neighbourhood holds a free community event in the park every July.

definition: a board on a wall where notices and announcements are posted
example: I saw the notice about the yoga class on the bulletin board at the library.

definition: a printed sheet of paper that advertises an event or service
example: Volunteers put up flyers about the clean-up day at local coffee shops.

definition: a short regular report sent to members of a group or residents
example: The community centre sends out a monthly newsletter with upcoming programs.

definition: a library or community session where someone reads stories aloud to children
example: The library offers free story time for toddlers every Wednesday morning.

definition: to visit a place briefly, usually without planning it in advance
example: Feel free to drop by the front desk if you have questions about registration.

definition: to give something to each person in a group
example: Volunteers handed out free hot drinks at the winter festival.

definition: to reserve a library item so it is kept for you when it becomes available
example: You can place a hold on the book online and pick it up at any branch.
collocations: place a hold on a book

definition: a box or slot where you can return library items when the library is closed
example: If the library is closed, just leave the books in the book drop outside.
collocations: return items to the book drop

definition: a meal where every guest brings a dish to share
vi: bữa tiệc mỗi người mang một món
example: Our building is having a potluck in the common room on Friday evening.
collocations: bring a dish to a potluck

definition: a party for all the people living on one street, often with the road closed to traffic
example: Our street got permission from the city to hold a block party in August.

definition: a place where free meals are served to people who need them
example: Every Sunday, she volunteers at a soup kitchen in the Downtown Eastside.

definition: a building where people without a home can sleep and get help
vi: nhà tạm trú cho người vô gia cư
example: The homeless shelter needs warm blankets and socks before winter.

definition: an event to collect food donations for people in need
example: Our office is running a food drive for the local food bank this month.

definition: a public place that opens during very cold weather so people without a warm place to stay can come inside
vi: điểm sưởi ấm tạm thời (mở khi trời rét)
example: When the temperature drops below freezing, the city opens warming centres in some libraries and community centres.

definition: to join with other people to help with a task or give money
example: Everyone in the neighbourhood pitched in to clean up the park.

definition: to take part in an activity or organization
example: Getting involved in local events is a great way for newcomers to meet people.
collocations: encourage people to get involved in

definition: to tell many people about something
vi: lan truyền thông tin, báo cho mọi người biết
example: Please help us spread the word about the free tax workshop.
collocations: spread the word on social media

definition: a group or space where people cook together to share skills and food
example: At the community kitchen, newcomers learn to cook healthy meals on a budget.

definition: organized activities or care for children after the school day ends
example: The after-school program keeps children busy until their parents finish work.
collocations: sign up for an after-school program

definition: to organize and manage a program or activity
example: A team of volunteers runs a program that helps seniors use smartphones.

definition: not having enough money, food or other basic things
example: The holiday hamper project supports families in need across the city.

definition: a person who looks after someone who is sick, elderly or disabled
vi: người chăm sóc (người già, người bệnh)
example: The centre runs a monthly support group for family caregivers.

definition: a group of residents who watch for crime and report it in their area
vi: nhóm cư dân canh chừng an ninh khu phố
example: After a series of break-ins, residents started a neighbourhood watch.

definition: a form you fill out to sign up for a program or service
example: Please complete the registration form and return it to the front desk.

definition: the people who live in a particular area
example: Local residents were invited to share their ideas for the new playground.

definition: a person who changes spoken words from one language into another (a translator works with written text)
example: The settlement office can arrange a Vietnamese interpreter for your appointment.

definition: a large container where people leave donated items
example: You can leave gently used clothing in the collection bin outside the community centre.
collocations: drop items in the collection bin

definition: a local non-profit centre, common in Metro Vancouver, that offers programs and support for people in the area
vi: nhà sinh hoạt cộng đồng khu phố (tổ chức phi lợi nhuận)
example: The neighbourhood house runs English conversation circles and a weekly seniors' lunch.

definition: a person who helps newcomers find housing, jobs and services in a new country
vi: nhân viên hỗ trợ định cư
example: A settlement worker helped my family find a school and open a bank account.

definition: a box or bag of donated food given to a family or person in need
example: Volunteers packed over two hundred food hampers for the holidays.

definition: to publicly support or speak in favour of a person, group or idea
example: The group advocates for better transit options for seniors.

definition: an official check to see whether a person has a criminal record, often needed for volunteer work
vi: kiểm tra lý lịch tư pháp
example: Volunteers who work with children must complete a criminal record check.

definition: a room that can be used for many different activities
example: The multipurpose room can be booked for meetings, birthday parties and fitness classes.

definition: welcoming to everyone, including people from all backgrounds and abilities
vi: hòa nhập, chào đón mọi người
example: The centre wants its programs to be inclusive and affordable for all families.

definition: a program in which an experienced person gives advice and support to someone less experienced
vi: chương trình cố vấn, kèm cặp
example: Through the mentorship program, I was matched with an engineer who had also immigrated.
collocations: be matched through a mentorship program

definition: help and encouragement given by people who have had similar experiences
example: The new parents' group offers peer support and practical tips.

definition: a phone service where trained people help callers who are in emotional distress
vi: đường dây nóng hỗ trợ khủng hoảng
example: The crisis line is open twenty-four hours a day for anyone who needs to talk.

definition: a place where people can get free or low-cost legal advice
vi: phòng tư vấn pháp lý (miễn phí)
example: A volunteer lawyer at the legal clinic explained my rights as a tenant.

definition: a free service where trained volunteers help people, often those with a modest income, file their income tax returns
vi: điểm hỗ trợ khai thuế miễn phí
example: Volunteers at the library tax clinic helped me file my return for free.

definition: partly paid for by the government or an organization so it costs less
example: The centre offers subsidized swimming lessons for families who cannot afford the full fee.

definition: a central place where local people can meet and access many services
vi: trung tâm cộng đồng, điểm kết nối cộng đồng
example: The renovated library has become a real community hub for the neighbourhood.

definition: the number of people who come to an event
example: There was a great turnout at the beach clean-up despite the rain.

definition: easily harmed or in need of special care and protection
example: During heat waves, staff check on vulnerable seniors who live alone.

definition: taking an active part in the life of your community, for example by voting or volunteering
vi: sự tham gia của người dân vào đời sống cộng đồng
example: The workshop aims to encourage civic engagement among young newcomers.

definition: started and organized by ordinary people in a community rather than by leaders or governments
vi: từ cơ sở, do người dân tự phát
example: What started as a grassroots campaign soon led to a new crosswalk near the school.

definition: not getting enough services or support compared with other groups or areas
vi: chưa được phục vụ đầy đủ
example: The mobile library brings books to underserved neighbourhoods.

definition: a system in which fees are lower for people who earn less
vi: mức phí linh hoạt theo thu nhập
example: The counselling service charges on a sliding scale, so fees depend on your income.

definition: involving people of different age groups, such as children and seniors
example: The intergenerational program pairs high school students with seniors to share stories.
